entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well that sucked.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is doing this really going to help[n]us do something about Medjed?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Do they truly intend to follow[n]through on their threat? It'd be a[n]shame if our efforts were a waste.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Medjed will definitely make a move.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Alibaba!

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: I'm checking in on your progress.[n]How much longer will it take?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Your heart is more problematic[n]than we had anticipated.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, Alibaba!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Can you really do something[n]about Medjed?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Of course.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Unfortunately, we have next to[n]no evidence to support that.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Your work will be rewarded.[n]I promise.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Besides... You have no[n]other option, do you?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I suppose that's true...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Can you do stuff like take[n]down a server? Show us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey! Don't start any trouble.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: That's all it would[n]take to convince you?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: All right. I ask that you[n]take care of this quickly.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Until then.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait! Are you ditching us again?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is troubling, but... we need[n]to do what we can at the moment.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have concern for Futaba[n]herself during all this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, why'd this have to be[n]during summer vacation?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We don't have any other choice.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: [fName]-kun. As always, we'll leave[n]it to you to call us together.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The sight of her Palace bothers me too...[n]We have to do this.
